To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Merlin is a tumor suppressor that inhibits CRL4(DCAF1) to restrain cell proliferation.
Merlin inhibits CRL4 ( DCAF1) activity in the nucleus and that this inhibition is required for Merlin to suppress cell proliferation and tumorigenesis.
Merlin inhibits the E2 ubiquitin ligase activity of CRL (DCAF1), a complex that regulates the activity of multiple transcription factors and other proteins.
